purpose: 三种怪怪的可爱角色概念探索；未接入客户端，未替换现有角色。

concepts.name: 雨伞水母
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one character concept image for the user's existing walking game, transparent cutout.
Input roles: Images 1-5 are the user's existing cast, STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: teapot, Wave, cloud, Lilroll, mismatch. Do not include or modify the reference characters. The new character must look drawn by the SAME ARTIST: confident slightly irregular BLACK comic contours, vivid restrained flat colors, modest hard cel-shadow patches and short ink hatching, like Wave/mismatch, with teapot/cloud's anthropomorphic-object charm.
Art direction: a little WEIRD but CUTE, eccentric and endearing rather than a generic smiley mascot. Let the oddness come from an unexpected silhouette, gently awkward proportions and a tiny deadpan expression. Keep the silhouette simple and readable, only two or three defining features, suitable for later small avatars and walking animation. Not horror, not grotesque, not glossy 3D, not watercolor, not a clean vector logo, not a large round-headed stickman, not an ordinary child simply wearing an object hat.
CAMERA IS STRICTLY EYE-LEVEL: level optical axis, no looking up or down, orthographic-style side-scroller illustration. Character facing and walking toward the RIGHT, side/very slight three-quarter side orientation but NO vertical perspective. Do not show broad top surfaces of the head or bottom shoe-tread surfaces. Both feet similar in scale, no dramatic foreground foot, no foreshortening.
Composition: exactly ONE complete full-body character in one naturally balanced walking stride, opposing arm/leg swing; entire head and feet visible; centered on square canvas with generous margins, around 80% of image height. Not a character sheet, multiple variants or a collage.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA, no painted background, checkerboard, scenery, floor line, ground shadow, decorative symbols, text, labels, logos or watermark.

Specific concept: UMBRELLA JELLY. A softly odd little creature whose main head/body is an INSIDE-OUT UMBRELLA, a wide lilac bowl-like canopy with turned-up scalloped edges, a few black rib/fold lines and two tiny uneven black oval eyes on the forward outer panel. One eye is slightly lower than the other; a tiny unsure mouth makes it look shy rather than scary. The silhouette is wide at the top, airy and wiggly underneath. A little opaque ivory jelly-like underside has only FOUR short simple ribbon appendages: two become small mitten-like hands, two become walking legs tucked into oversized warm-yellow rain boots. A single short curled umbrella-handle shape hangs like a silly little curl at the center, not an extra limb. Slightly mismatched boot height, still a coherent pair. The creature feels like a wind-flipped umbrella that awkwardly learned to walk. No human face under a hat, no regular shirt/pants, no extra tentacles, umbrella held in a hand or floating jellyfish. Lilac canopy, ivory appendages, mustard-yellow boots with small charcoal trim. In the level-camera view show the canopy's OUTSIDE side wall, not an overhead view into the bowl.

Specific concept: SNAIL COURIER. A lovable anthropomorphic snail who inexplicably has VERY LONG walking legs and VERY SHORT arms. A small warm peach snail body, a compact snail face with TWO eye-stalks at slightly different heights: one is half-asleep while the other is patiently looking ahead. No human hair or human face, no normal child's head. A single big dusty-blue spiral shell on its back, with one clear ink spiral, gives a rounded offset silhouette. One tiny plain cardboard parcel is simply strapped against the shell with a coral strap; no text or stamps. The short arms barely reach around its belly, giving it a mildly absurd determined stance. Long pale-peach cartoon legs with knees, not stick strokes, and simple coral-red canvas walking shoes with white toe caps/soles. No complete human outfit; one tiny coral neckerchief only. The joke is that a supposedly slow creature walks earnestly on comically long legs, but the face remains gentle and calm. Compact head, shell-heavy middle, gangly bottom; clearly unlike a robot or umbrella creature. No slime trail, extra shell, extra eyes or extra limbs. EYE-LEVEL side-view anatomy, both eye stalks visible through a slight horizontal head turn, not a pitched camera.

Specific concept: SLEEPWALKING DESK LAMP. A sleepy, slightly clumsy personified lamp with a small warm-yellow trapezoid lampshade that has slipped too low over its milky-white bulb face. Only two half-lidded oval eyes peek from beneath the lower rim, one more closed than the other. No glowing aura; the bulb is drawn as a flat opaque ivory cartoon form. A short crooked flexible lamp-stem neck creates a gently bent silhouette, NOT a complex robot assembly. Soft squat torso in a loose powder-blue pajama shirt with just two or three folds and one crooked pocket; rounded ivory arms and relatively short legs. Large mismatched-position lilac house slippers, one lifted slightly in a hesitant walking step, both seen from the SIDE with no shoe-sole undersides. A thin simple power cord forms ONE curled tail at the back ending in a small plug, held off the imaginary ground, not additional limbs or tangled wires. One hand lazily holds the drooping lampshade rim while the other hangs sleepily, natural balance. Endearingly odd, quietly stubborn, NOT a cheerful toy robot, no metal armor, weapons, large antenna or human hair. Amber/lilac/soft blue palette. The lampshade reads as a sideways trapezoid profile with no large top or underside cavity visible; strict LEVEL EYE-LEVEL view.
